posts.text:
Historic tax relief is here this Tax Day!

From major Social Security tax cuts for seniors to no taxes on tips and overtime for working families, the Trump Tax Cuts are helping Americans keep more of what they earn.

Republicans put MORE in your pocket. LESS to the IRS. That's putting Americans FIRST.

Video

I’m honored to have the support of the Associated Builders and Contractors of Florida. As our state continues to grow, we must have a plan in place to support that growth. 

As Governor, I’ll fight to cut burdensome regulations, expand workforce training, and ensure our construction industry has the tools it needs to keep building Florida’s future. 

That means more jobs, stronger communities, and a state that continues to lead the nation in economic opportunity.

You have to use an ID to get on a plane, buy alcohol, and sign a lease. 

You should have to use one to vote.  

I don't listen to the Democrat arguments anymore because they assume people are ignorant and can't fend for themselves.

Video

As a Nole during his time as coach, I got to experience first-hand the magic Bobby Bowden brought to Tallahassee. 

He shaped more than just a football program. He built a legacy and helped define what makes FSU so special. 

Proud to see the legendary Coach Bowden honored with this lasting tribute, and as always, Go Noles!


Ron DeSantis (@GovRonDeSantis)

Bobby Bowden - Tallahassee International Airport is now official!





— https://nitter.net/GovRonDeSantis/status/2044152069263655233#m

I 100% support deporting illegals. 

I supported it when President Trump ran in 2024. 

I support it today.

Video

My commitment to Floridians: the state will be efficient with the resources you have given us. 

The people of Florida demand no less. 

Your government is going to be responsible and ruthlessly efficient with the dollars you trust us with.

Video

The Defending the Florida Dream Tour is headed to Escambia County! Join us THIS SATURDAY, April 18, for a rally at The Fish House in Pensacola. 

Doors open at 10:00 AM. We’ll see you there! 🇺🇸😎

RSVP HERE: byrondonalds.com/pensacola

Whether it’s building our roads or launching rockets, Florida’s future depends on giving people real pathways to succeed.

Today in Broward County, we announced LaunchPad, my promise to Floridians to cut red tape, expand apprenticeships, and help people across the state build a strong future without being buried in debt.

📍We are LIVE from Broward County

Video
Live at the ABC Institute nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1dGYljkqM…

President Trump is using every lever possible to bring this situation under control once and for all.

A nuclear Iran is simply UNACCEPTABLE. 

They are a Theocratic regime that is hellbent on jihad and hellbent on spreading terror around the globe.

Video

The Iranians have ALWAYS used the Strait of Hormuz as economic terrorism against the West to protect their Theocratic regime.

President Trump is doing what's necessary to accomplish the main objectives: 

- Make sure Iran does not have a nuclear weapon
- Significantly degrade their ballistic missile capabilities

Video

Díaz-Canel is a dictator who wants to rule Cuba with an iron fist. 

For 67 years, Cuba has been a Communist dictatorship. They have suppressed the free speech of the Cuban people. The Cuban people today are rationing food. Their economy is flat on its back.

We need full-scale regime change in Cuba NOW.

Video

Díaz-Canel's claim that no changes need to be made for Cuba to be better is a LIE. 

The Cuban regime is a state sponsor of terrorism that HAS TO GO.

My full conversation with @kwelkernbc / @MeetThePress

Video

Join us MONDAY, APRIL 13, in Broward County for another stop on the Defending the Florida Dream Tour! 🇺🇸 🇺🇸

RSVP HERE: tinyurl.com/5ytc7ecx
